# function: imagebuilder_all_workflow_build_versions

Builds the ARN of an `imagebuilder` `allWorkflowBuildVersions`:

```
arn:${Partition}:imagebuilder:${Region}:${Account}:workflow/${WorkflowType}/${WorkflowName}/${WorkflowVersion}/*
```

`${Partition}`, `${Region}` and `${Account}` come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
imagebuilder_all_workflow_build_versions(workflow_type string, workflow_name string, workflow_version string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `workflow_type` (String) Value for `${WorkflowType}` in the ARN template.
1. `workflow_name` (String) Value for `${WorkflowName}` in the ARN template.
1. `workflow_version` (String) Value for `${WorkflowVersion}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given.
